name: SepsisGuard
description: Multi-agent SEP-1 bundle co-pilot. Screens emerging sepsis, executes the CMS SEP-1 3-hr/6-hr bundle, drafts CMS-abstractor-grade documentation. FHIR-native; reads vitals, labs, and free-text nursing notes; writes Task, Communication, and DocumentReference resources.

extensions.description: FHIR context (X-FHIR-Server-URL, X-FHIR-Access-Token, X-Patient-ID) for sepsis bundle execution.

skills.name: Watch a patient for emerging sepsis
skills.description: Continuously screen the patient for SIRS/qSOFA criteria and free-text signals in nursing notes / DiagnosticReports. Surfaces a SepsisAlert if criteria are met without committing to bundle execution.

skills.name: Execute the CMS SEP-1 bundle for a confirmed sepsis case
skills.description: Drive each 3-hr and 6-hr SEP-1 bundle element to completion. Creates Task resources for nursing/pharmacy/lab, drafts antibiotic regimens for clinician sign-off, notifies the care team, and drafts the abstractor-grade SEP-1 documentation note.

skills.name: Audit a completed sepsis encounter for SEP-1 compliance
skills.description: Walk a discharged patient's record and predict whether the encounter passes CMS SEP-1 abstractor review. Returns a compliance score and a punch-list of audit concerns.
